CounselingSlot.title: CounselingSlot
CounselingSlot.description: A single student counseling slot booking for a specific weekday (2026-11-17 to 2026-12-23, excluding weekends) and time slot (1 or 2).

date.description: Weekday date in YYYY-MM-DD format within the 27-weekday counseling schedule (2026-11-17 to 2026-12-23).

slotNumber.description: Time slot index for the day: 1 (첫번째 타임) or 2 (두번째 타임).

studentName.description: Name of the student registered for this counseling slot.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the booking was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the booking was last updated.

AdminVerification.title: AdminVerification
AdminVerification.description: Write-only atomic verification record used in write batches to authorize teacher modifications and deletions.

passcode.description: Admin verification passcode validated via SHA-256 hash in security rules.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp matching the batch request time.

/counselingSlots/{slotId}.description: Stores student counseling slot bookings keyed by deterministic ID YYYY-MM-DD_slotNumber.

/adminVerifications/{slotId}.description: Write-only verification gate paired atomically with admin updates and deletes on counselingSlots.
